value.title: What TrustLens concluded

value.purpose: Each categorical axis shown separately with its own question.

value.title: Why

value.title: Unknowns, ambiguities, limitations and degraded evaluation

value.title: Recommended next steps
value.purpose: Governed action codes in response order with their governed instructions and policy basis.

value.title: How this result was produced

value.title: Interpretation notice

| Section | Key | Title | Accepted fields | Views |

value.purpose: The governed rules that matched, with the governing rule identified when one is returned.

value.title: Sources and provenance
value.purpose: Governed source references behind matched rules; provenance types kept distinct; observations not exposed by the result API.

value.title: Per-rule outcomes (matched, indeterminate, suppressed, not applicable, not matched)
value.purpose: The per-rule decomposition, grouped by outcome, for an assigned analyst with content permission.

value.title: Unknowns, ambiguities, limitations and degraded evaluation
value.purpose: What remains unknown or ambiguous, the limitations, and whether evaluation was degraded.

value.title: Recommended next steps
value.purpose: Governed action codes in response order with their governed instructions and policy basis.

value.title: How this result was produced
value.purpose: Pinned engine, contract and knowledge-bundle provenance, and governed AI usage metadata.

value.title: Interpretation notice
value.purpose: The not-an-official-determination disclaimer and, for NO_SCAM_PATTERN, the returned absence-of-finding notice.
